Case: Patient D is a 52-year-old Asian man who is post-op day 4 status-post L3-L4 laminectomy for lumbar stenosis. Surgery was uncomplicated, and he has met goals for discharge. On physical examination, you confirm that he is neurologically intact and has expected tenderness to palpation of his lower back at the surgical site. Question: Would you offer a oxycodone prescription to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
